name: M3_PPS200MI_AddLine
description: Create a new purchase order line on an existing purchase order. The operation adds an item, quantity, logistics data, pricing, tax, project, and user‑defined information to the purchase order header already stored in M3. It relies on standard purchase master data (item, supplier, agreements, order type, etc.) to derive many defaults, which you can override through the available input fields. Lines for subcontracting purchase orders are not allowed here; such orders must be handled in the subcontracting purchase order function (PPS170). No data is returned; read operations must be used separately to retrieve the created line.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number to which the new line will be added.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number ordered on the new purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: ORQA

inputParameters.name: PNLI

inputParameters.name: PNLS
